lines: With no network, Telo Ride says why live races and group classes are closed, the moment it happens.
On Race Setup, Riders online closes and says you're offline; Bots, the default, is chosen in its place.
On Class Start, Ride with a group closes with its reason, and Ride alone is chosen, ready to start.
Offline, neither screen asks the service anything. Back online, both ask again at once, and the choice opens.
Offline, unreachable or open: one small rule decides, and the screen says which, in words.
Race Setup offline, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: the reason shows at once, the choice falls back, and it all opens again online.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
